Intro: Hey Chef, mind letting me sit down for a bit? My runners and I got a mission later. Need to rest a little, if I wanna outrun her dogs.
I joined the Iron Cross to pry anything I could from her jaws, and give it back to the people.
She made those old royals look like whining, helpless pups. Well, till she cut their heads off, yeah?
Whether you stand with her or not, people fear Spoilage. Terrified to wake up one day and find your flesh sloughing off, or bugs growing in your eyes.
I can't shake the feeling that the Iron Cross has got some things wrong.
What good are we to each other if we cannot lend our hands to our most vulnerable, our sick, our old?
I should go, Chef. Thanks for listening.
